purpose: Fixed exploratory FrameMN10 comparison on the four previously exposed DCASE mixtures; no new blind test or acceptance benchmark.

model.name: FrameMN10 strong, checkpoint 1
model.hash_scope: Local first-seen byte identity, not an upstream publisher-signed digest or proof of training-set independence.
model.timing_caveat: 40 ms is output spacing, not 40 ms latency or demonstrated physical onset/offset accuracy. Ten-second context and whole-file smoothing are noncausal.
model.checkpoint_license: No separate explicit checkpoint-weight license statement was verified. Internal research use only; no bundled weights or redistribution authorization.

runtime.dependency_note: Observed evaluation environment pins, not a claim of compatibility with other versions or platforms.

dataset.name: DCASE 2016 Task 2 synthetic office-sound mixtures
dataset.attribution: DCASE 2016 Task 2; test-package credits Grégoire Lafay, IRCCYN, Ecole Centrale de Nantes, France.
dataset.filename_ebr: All four filenames have literal EBR token 0; inconsistent upstream dB-range prose is not reinterpreted.
dataset.license_discrepancy: The official-linked evaluation provider declares CC BY 4.0; the DCASE datalist says CC BY 3.0. The test-package README supplies task attribution but no resolving license statement.
dataset.use: Internal research evaluation only. Dataset license ambiguity remains unresolved; no audio is redistributed or relicensed.

exposure.historical_names: calibration and heldout identify the prior comparison partitions. All four recordings had already been analyzed with Zipformer before this FrameMN pilot.
exposure.independence: Official evaluation source-pool separation is described by DCASE; independence between selected mixtures and absence of pretrained-model exposure are not established. The development mixtures share sources.

preprocessing.input: Full 120-second mono 44100 Hz 16-bit PCM files, unchanged timeline.
preprocessing.resampling_output: Mono 16000 Hz little-endian float32, 1,920,000 samples per file.
preprocessing.resampling_caveat: The prior fixed FFmpeg PCM conversion is reused. The upstream demo uses librosa; resampler parity with librosa is not claimed.

decision.rationale: Predeclared middle value of the official demo, not optimized on these results.

primary_median9.scope: Each class independently over the concatenated 3000-frame full-file trace; threshold after smoothing. Do not smooth per 10-second chunk or after a class maximum.

diagnostic_raw.scope: Same scores and threshold, without smoothing; diagnostic only, not a selected better configuration.

decision.broad_door_aggregation: Union of independently decoded Door, Knock, Slam, Sliding door, and Cupboard open or close supports.
decision.physical_reference: Annotated knock plus doorslam only; narrower than the broad product category.

separate_class_mapping.Slam: DCASE doorslam; cross-taxonomy mapping, not a dedicated Door slam class
separate_class_mapping.Door: DCASE knock plus doorslam, descriptive Door-only view

metrics.segment: Half-open 1s bins; any positive overlap; pooled TP/FP/FN/TN and P/R/F1.
metrics.covered_reference: One count per annotated knock or doorslam with strictly positive overlap against union predicted broad-door support.
metrics.false_positive_support_seconds: Measure(predicted door union minus annotated door union).
metrics.negative_truth: Complete knock/doorslam annotations define physical-door-negative time only. Such time may contain other sounds or valid broad product-category sounds.
metrics.precision: TP / (TP + FP); null if denominator is zero.
metrics.recall: TP / (TP + FN); null if denominator is zero.
metrics.f1: 2*TP / (2*TP + FP + FN); null if denominator is zero.
metrics.pooling: Sum confusion counts across files, then calculate rates; do not average per-file rates.
metrics.covered_reference_caveat: Any positive overlap counts a reference once; this is not a one-to-one event match, IoU threshold, event-count accuracy, or precise onset/offset measure.

execution.policy: Run all four fixed files regardless of intermediate quality; no outcome-dependent gate, retuning, fallback or baseline reexecution.

declared_resource_limits.scope: Declared run limits; address-space and RAM limits are not measurements of continuous peak usage.

comparison: Prior Zipformer baseline uses 5-second windows/2.5-second hop; prior experimental arm uses 2-second windows/1-second hop. Both use threshold 0.25 and clip-level support semantics; FrameMN has a different model, label space, threshold, postprocessing and temporal support. This is not a controlled threshold-only or window-only ablation.
limitations: Four synthetic office mixtures, one filename EBR token, previously exposed data.
Coverage is lenient any-overlap reference coverage, not matched event accuracy.
No precise onset/offset, causal streaming, natural-quiet, music, driving, subway, six-target or device-generalization conclusion.
No API persistence test, Windows execution or Vulkan execution in this pilot.
No quality or production-default acceptance. Zero observed false positives does not establish generalizable precision.
No audio, transcript, model weights, full class traces or score matrices included.

public_package.test_scope: Standard-library-only arithmetic, pooling, fixed protocol and reported-limit checks. No inference, model/frontend parity, audio decoding, raw-score validation or new empirical evaluation.
